criterion: Matches the branch + lanterns at the left of the reference stairs shot.
note: Position and pods match the reference: limb from x 0 to 0.33 at y 0.30-0.36, orange pods at 0.21 and 0.26 (reference 0.208 / 0.255). The limb itself does not: a pale smooth tapered tube about half the reference's thickness, with sparse upright leaf sprigs and dangling vines, no moss cap, no bark relief. The reference's is a dark, heavy, mossy bough (1.2-1.5 m) hazed into the mist. Survey-2 #04 (w04-spine-l: stucco-noise pale tube) still describes it at frame scale. Crop x 0.0-0.45, y 0.18-0.52.
